description: Port areas is a dataset listed in OpenDataScienceEurope, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver-dev.opendatascience.eu. 123: Infrastructure of port areas (land and water surface), including quays, dockyards and marinas. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include Geoharmonizer, geodata, Europe, geoharvester, Land cover, land use and administrative data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendatascienceeurope.
